name: New York University
summary: NYU was founded in 1831 and is one of the largest private universities in the US, with 29,471 undergraduates in fall 2025. Applicants apply to a specific school — such as the College of Arts and Science or the Stern School of Business — and NYU is test-optional through the 2027-28 cycle. The NYU Promise meets full demonstrated need for first-year students on the New York campus, international students included.

testing.notes: Test-optional through the 2027-28 application cycle for every school and programme.

internationalTuition.notes: Tuition and fees: US$68,576 for most schools; US$70,464 at Stern.

scholarships.name: The NYU Promise
scholarships.eligibility: Every first-year admitted to the New York campus — domestic or international — has 100% of demonstrated need met with scholarships and grants; families earning under US$100,000 with typical assets pay no tuition. International applicants submit the CSS Profile by the deadline.

admissionStats.scope: First-year applicants to the New York campus, Class of 2029
admissionStats.notes: "More than 120,000" applicants; CAS, Stern and Nursing each admitted fewer than 5%.

admissionProcess.detail: Apply to a specific NYU school (e.g. Stern or the College of Arts and Science).
Early Decision I by 1 November (decision 15 December) or Regular Decision by 5 January (decision 1 April).
SAT/ACT may be sent but aren't required through the 2027-28 cycle.
Submit the CSS Profile by the deadline — international first-years are eligible for need-based aid.

feeBreakdown.notes: Books US$1,492, transport US$2,438, personal US$2,054. Total cost of attendance US$100,998 (US$102,886 at Stern).
